_readme: Gross monthly household income ceilings for resale-flat grants, in SGD. Each figure needs a source page, the date it took effect and the date someone checked it. Set verified=true only after checking the official HDB/CPF page or the team's dated policy snapshot. Do not edit a figure without updating its source fields.

cpf_housing_grant_family.label: CPF Housing Grant (Family), resale
cpf_housing_grant_family.applies_to: Married couples / families, at least one SC applicant, first-timer
cpf_housing_grant_family.note: Verified 2026-10-16 (Person 4) against HDB policy snapshot 2026-10-15, data/policy_snapshots/2026-10-15/clean/hdb-grant-family-cpf-housing-grants.md. Previously cited https://propertykakis.sg/blog/hdb-resale-grants-explained-2026/. Was $14,000 before the August 2026 income ceiling changes. Secondary source only.

cpf_housing_grant_single.label: CPF Housing Grant (Singles), resale
cpf_housing_grant_single.applies_to: Single SC aged 35 and above, first-timer
cpf_housing_grant_single.note: Verified 2026-10-16 (Person 4) against HDB policy snapshot 2026-10-15, data/policy_snapshots/2026-10-15/clean/hdb-grant-singles-cpf-housing-grant.md. Previously cited https://propertykakis.sg/blog/hdb-resale-grants-explained-2026/. Was $7,000 before the August 2026 changes.

enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_family.label: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Families)
enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_family.applies_to: First-timer families; grant amount falls as income rises
enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_family.note: Verified 2026-10-16 (Person 4) against HDB policy snapshot 2026-10-15, data/policy_snapshots/2026-10-15/clean/hdb-grant-family-ehg.md. Previously cited https://propertykakis.sg/blog/hdb-resale-grants-explained-2026/. No change reported in August 2026.

enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_single.label: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Singles)
enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_single.applies_to: First-timer singles; for joint singles / mixed couples the rules assess half the household income
enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_single.note: Verified 2026-10-16 (Person 4) against HDB policy snapshot 2026-10-15, data/policy_snapshots/2026-10-15/clean/hdb-grant-singles-ehg.md. Previously cited https://propertykakis.sg/blog/hdb-resale-grants-explained-2026/.

proximity_housing_grant.label: Proximity Housing Grant
proximity_housing_grant.applies_to: Buying to live with or near parents / married child
proximity_housing_grant.note: No income ceiling. Not verifiable from snapshot 2026-10-15: the singles PHG page does not mention income, which does not prove there is no ceiling.
